# Short links on your own domain, with stats that don't track people.

> A free, open-source alternative to Bitly, Dub and Rebrandly: your own short domain, UTM-tagged campaign links, iOS/Android app routing, expiry, click limits and privacy-friendly stats with no cookies and no stored IPs. Plan a batch of links in your browser first.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
